data.change_summary: Implemented stage-structured shrimp population dynamics with a Lefkovitch cohort model. AnimalState now contains three StageCohort instances (juvenile at 0.05g, sub-adult at 0.08g, adult at 0.12g), each with independent count, reserve_g, condition_index, and maturation_accum. Deterministic forward transitions (juvenile→sub-adult at 30d base, sub-adult→adult at 20d base) are gated by per-stage condition thresholds and temperature-scaled. An explicit molt cycle with timer-based readiness, success/failure tracking, and failed_molt_accum mortality penalty is integrated. Stage-aware feeding (weight allocation 1.0/0.67/0.3), per-stage mortality (sensitivity 1.5x/1.2x/1.0x juveniles/sub-adults/adults), stage-aware reproduction (only adults become berried, clutch size condition-dependent, hatched juveniles funded from adult reserve), and per-stage bioload routing are all implemented. Save migration v4→v5 distributes legacy flat reserve proportionally across stages. Snapshot/TUI/API expose per-stage breakdown with backward-compatible total-population accessors (total_count, population_condition_index, feeding_units).
outstanding_risks: One pre-existing TUI test failure (rejects_invalid_integer_counts) from TrimPlants refactor is unrelated to this task and should be fixed in its own scope
Population condition index uses count-weighted average rather than biomass-weighted; acceptable approximation since per-stage conditions are available individually for systems that need them

Molt cycle parameters (28-day base interval, 0.15 failed_molt_mortality_scale, 0.3/0.5 accum increments) are initial estimates that may need tuning against observed Neocaridina biology - all exposed in ShrimpRuntimeParams for adjustment

Condition update applies the same target to all three stages (no stage-specific sensitivity modifiers beyond the separate condition_index tracking); future work could add juvenile_sensitivity as a condition multiplier if differentiation is needed

steps.description: Define StageCohort struct with count, reserve_g, condition_index, maturation_accum fields and Default impl in types/biology.rs

Restructure AnimalState to contain adult, sub_adult, juvenile StageCohort instances plus berried_females_count subset bookkeeping, molt lifecycle fields, hourly stress accumulators, and egg cohort tracking
Add ShrimpRuntimeParams with stage transition timings (juvenile_to_subadult_days=30, subadult_to_adult_days=20), condition thresholds, molt interval, clutch size, and body composition parameters

Implement backward-compatible accessor methods on AnimalState: total_count(), feeding_units(), population_condition_index(), total_reserve_g(), add_reserve_by_feeding_units(), try_spend_reserve_g(), transfer_dead_reserve_g()
Implement stage-aware shrimp_feeding() with proportional allocation by feeding weight (adult=1.0, sub_adult=0.67, juvenile=0.3) and route_consumed_food() distributing retained reserve per-stage
Implement per-stage update_condition() applying 8-factor condition model independently to each stage's condition_index with smoothing
Implement explicit molt_cycle() with timer-based readiness, mineral/condition gates for success, failed_molt_accum penalty tracking, and molt stress blending
Implement spawning() restricted to adult cohort with condition-dependent clutch sizing, EggCohort creation, and temperature/mineral/stability probability modifiers
Implement egg_development() with per-cohort incubation advancement, clutch-resolution invariant, hatched juvenile funding from adult reserve, and resource-limited failure events

Implement juvenile_to_subadult() and subadult_to_adult() deterministic forward transitions with fractional maturation accumulators, condition gates, temperature scaling, reserve-funded biomass growth, and proportional reserve transfer

Implement stage-aware mortality() with per-stage sensitivity multipliers, failed molt penalty, maturation_accum scaling on death, and route_dead_shrimp_to_detritus() transferring body biomass plus per-stage reserve to fine detritus
Add save migration v4→v5 distributing legacy flat reserve/condition proportionally into StageCohort structs with sub_adult initialized at count=0 and idempotent safety check
Update TankSnapshot with sub_adult_count field and population-weighted shrimp_condition_index from all three stages; update TUI biology and overview screens to display per-stage breakdown
Expand N/C budget arrays to include sub-adult stage components and update biomass calculation helpers (shrimp_biomass_g) to use all three stage counts
Add comprehensive unit tests for feeding routing, oxygen-limited respiration, carbonate-condition integration, and stage transition mechanics
